[Leosquarez1984] Just to clarify, these are all individual outlet pieces. We don't order stock specifically for the outlet.
Products come from cancelled orders, refurbished items, ex-display stock and other one-off situations. Each piece has its own history, condition and price, which is why you may see different prices for what appears to be the similar product.
If you'd like clarification on a specific item, our customer service team will be happy to help.
Otherwise, I'd appreciate keeping the discussion constructive so we don't waste everyone's time.
[Wiadro] @Leosquarez1984:
I'd appreciate keeping the discussion constructive so we don't waste everyone's time.

[freefall101] Despite that @Wiadro posts every 13 seconds, they’re not OzBargain on a whole.
They’re not responsible for all the other deals posted on here. Plenty of small businesses post crap generic deals on Ozbargain looking for a sales boost and this is no different.
The question is always - what is the deal? Is there a good product at a good price here? If there is, promote that. $100 off an unknown entity is not a bargain in and of itself.

Anyway I'd appreciate keeping OzB for actual bargains so we don't waste everyone's time. I can't see any listed again.
